scope: Mixed provenance, not a reread of all eleven repositories. freeze_commit identifies the unchanged ten-build baseline only.

_comment: Provenance of data/build-by-build.json, a committed snapshot of the Build by
Build inventory. The homepage draws its matrix from this file at render time
(tools/build_bbb_grid.py) and the stat strip recomputes its two portfolio
figures from it; nothing is fetched. tools/check_references.py asserts the
file's sha256 equals `sha256` below and that it holds ten rows with fourteen
surface keys each. A refreeze of the matrix is a deliberate pull request that
replaces the snapshot and this record together.
